content.description: Axelar provides a secure, open protocol for cross-chain messaging, enabling end users to interact with any asset or application across any blockchain with a single click. From a developer perspective, it offers a straightforward API layered over a permissionless network that routes cross-chain messages and maintains security through proof-of-stake consensus. This design supports interoperable dApps, simplifies asset transfers, and enables cross-chain calls without fragmenting the user experience.
content.meta: Axelar delivers secure cross-chain communication. Discover Axelar and other Infrastructure Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
